_comment: Topic rules for mnemosyne-obsidian-mirror. Copy to ~/.hermes/mnemosyne-obsidian/categories.json and edit. First match wins: a memory goes to the first topic whose `sources` include its Mnemosyne source, or whose `keywords` (case-insensitive substrings) appear in its text. Unmatched memories go to General. Topic names must not equal a type name (Preferences, Facts, ...).
